content: Turkurkunam
Jius vdwgv Doonualu kochinglo, Vjwng alugv aru doonyi nyilin rilo, Meri Magdalene okv dvbv Meri akonv nyibung nga kaalwkbv vngtoku.
Lamdokpada dubv hoka moobi go achialvbv hwkto; nyidomooku tolokv Ahtu gv nyidogindung ngv itoku, vlwng nga ngora jitola okv hoka dootung toku.
Hv dooriak jvbv kaanam go, okv ninyigv vjiv tapam aingbv yapung toji toku.
Dakyanv sipai vdwv bunu achialvbv busu sungak laku jinjinpaparla nyi sinv aingbv rinya toku.
Nyidogindung ngv mvvga vdwa mintoku. “Nonuno busu rungma bvka, ngo chindu nonu daapo lo takkinam Jisunyi makar dunvgo.
Nw si domakv; nw turrapla gudung ropvkunv, ninyigv minam aingbv. Soka aala kaatoka ninyigv karku a.

Vjak baapubv vngnyika, okv ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa minpa jilaka, ‘Nw sinam lokv turkur pvkunv, okv vjak nonua vngchoyala Galili bv vngdungdo; hoka nonu ninyia kaapa reku!’ Ngo nonua ogugo minpvdw mvngpa laka.”
Vkvlvgabv bunu baapubv nyibung nga vngyu toku, busu bvla okv mvngpu bvla ritola, ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa minpa dubv joktoku.
Lamdokpada dubv Jisu bunua kaarwksula okv minto, “Mvngpuv nonugv lvkobv dooming gvlaka.” Bunu nw gvlo aatoku okv ninyigv lvpa nga jarbwng nyatola ninyia kumnyajonya toku.
Jisu bunua minto, “Busu mabvka, vngnyila ngoogv boru vdwa Galili lo vngdubv minpa jiteka, okv hoka bunu ngam kaapa reku.”
Nyibung nga dakyanv vdwgv minpakunam
Mvvga vdwgv lamtvlo vngdungrilo, nyibung nga dakrianv sipai megonv pamtv bv vngkur lakula ogugo ripvkudw ho mvnwngnga Nyibu butvnv vdwa minpa jitoku.
Nyibu Butvnv vdwv nyigagaatv vdwa kaarwksula bunugv mvngnam a rungtoku; bunu sipai vdwa morko achialvbv jitola
okv minto, “Nonu vbv minlaka, nonugv yupla doorilo, ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwv ayu bv aala ninyigv svma nga dvchoola baggv yinv vlaka.
Okv so yunying sum gobunor tvvpa bolo, ngonu ninyia tvvlwk dubv minre, ho vdwv chimapvnv vla, ho lvgabv nonu mvngdwk mabvka.”
Nyibung nga Kaayanv sipai vdwv morko nga naagvrikula, bunugv minkubv riji toku. Okv vkvlvgabv so yunying sum Jius nyi vdwv vjaklodvbv dugola dupwng modu.
Jisu ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa kaarwk sitoku
Lvbwlaksu vring gula akin vdwv Jisu gv vnglakv vku Galili gv moodw lo vngtoku.
Vdwlo bunu ninyia kaapa tokudw, kvgonv mvngjwng matolaka, bunu nvnyia kumtojotoku.
Jisu bunugv nvchilo aala minto, “Ngam nyidomooku okv sichingmooku mvnwngnga rigvdogv nvgobv jipvkunv.
Vbvrikunamv, nyi vdw mvnwng gvlo vngnyika okv bunua ngoogv lvbwlaksubv mvteritekuka: bunua Abu gvla, Kuunyilo gvla, okv Darwknv Dow gv amin bv baptisma jilaka,
okv ngoogv nonua gamki nama bunua tamsar gvrila tvvmurimu laka. Okv ngo alu gv dwkibv nonua lvkobv reming gvvre, ataranya alu lobv.”
